intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Welcome to the Mars Detective Club, Captain Pebble.

intro.speaker: ziggy
intro.text: Beep boop! Hi Captain! I'm Ziggy, your flying detective assistant. I'm 87% genius and 13% propeller.

intro.speaker: ziggy
intro.text: Our first case is a BIG one: Case #001. Did Mars ever have water?

intro.speaker: ziggy
intro.text: Nope! Real detectives find clues. NASA left three old machines on Mars, and each one discovered something important.

intro.speaker: ziggy
intro.text: Find them, scan them, and collect 3 Evidence Cards. Then we crack the case together!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: This is a virtual Mars. The real machines are far apart, so their true landing sites are written on every Evidence Card.

viking1_intro.speaker: ziggy
viking1_intro.text: Look! An old lander with long legs. That's Viking 1, from 1976!

viking1_intro.speaker: ziggy
viking1_intro.text: It did experiments on Mars soil. Was it growing potatoes or what?

viking1_intro.speaker: ziggy
viking1_intro.text: Just kidding. It was searching for signs of LIFE. Let's open its file!

viking1_outro.speaker: ziggy
viking1_outro.text: So the soil did weird things, but that's not proof of life. Careful detectives don't jump to conclusions!

viking1_outro.speaker: ziggy
viking1_outro.text: Clue #1 saved. Follow the arrow to the next machine!

opportunity_intro.speaker: ziggy
opportunity_intro.text: Whoa, a rover with solar wings! Meet Opportunity.

opportunity_intro.speaker: pebble
opportunity_intro.text: It looks tiny for a planet this big.

opportunity_intro.speaker: ziggy
opportunity_intro.text: Tiny but tough! It was supposed to work for 90 days... and kept going for almost 15 YEARS.

opportunity_intro.speaker: ziggy
opportunity_intro.text: It studied rocks. Wait, is that rock older than my grandpa?

opportunity_outro.speaker: ziggy
opportunity_outro.text: Rocks that formed in water! So Mars had water a long, long time ago.

opportunity_outro.speaker: ziggy
opportunity_outro.text: Clue saved. One more machine is waiting for us!

phoenix_intro.speaker: ziggy
phoenix_intro.text: Brrr! It's cold up here near the north pole. That's the Phoenix lander!

phoenix_intro.speaker: ziggy
phoenix_intro.text: Phoenix had a robot arm made for digging. Like a sandcastle champion, but on Mars.

phoenix_intro.speaker: ziggy
phoenix_intro.text: Something hiding just under the dust. Let's find out!

phoenix_outro.speaker: ziggy
phoenix_outro.text: Wait... so there's water here, but it's pretending to be ice?! Sneaky!

case_ready.speaker: ziggy
case_ready.text: Captain! We have ALL 3 Evidence Cards!

case_ready.speaker: ziggy
case_ready.text: Time to put them on the case board and solve Case #001. Detective mode: ON!
